# TheBoxMakers

> TheBoxMakers offers corrugated boxes and custom packaging options for businesses. Product requirements and pricing are confirmed through an enquiry.

## Business information
- Website: https://theboxmakers.com/
- Location: Sector 102, Gurugram, Haryana 122505, India
- Sales email: sales@theboxmakers.com
- Phone: +91 8920894998

## Packaging options
- Standard corrugated boxes
- Custom printed mailer boxes
- Heavy-duty shipping boxes
- Gift boxes
- Food and takeaway packaging options (material suitability must be confirmed for intended use)
- Custom die-cut boxes

Specifications, available materials, minimum quantities, sample availability, production timing, and delivery terms vary by requirement. Contact the team to confirm before ordering. Prices are not published as fixed unit rates.

## Requesting a quote
Include the box type, internal dimensions (length × width × height), quantity, printing or finish, intended use, and delivery city. Ask the team to confirm material suitability, pricing, sample availability, and schedule for the specific requirement.
